case_name: Smt. Shilpa @ Ashwini vs Sri. Manjappa S
acts_cited_auto: Protection of Women from DV Act, 2005

acts_cited.act: Protection of Women from DV Act, 2005

facts_of_case: Petitioner/wife filed a petition under Section 24 of CPC to transfer M.C.No.11/2023 from Senior Civil Judge and JMFC, Shikaripura to Family Court at Shivamogga.

legal_principles.principle: In matrimonial cases, the Court shall have to take note of the inconvenience or hardship that would be caused to the wife.
legal_principles.held: The Court shall have to take note of the inconvenience or hardship that would be caused to the wife along with social and economic factors.

legal_principles.principle: The Court shall consider the social and economic factors while deciding a petition for transfer of proceedings.
legal_principles.held: The Court shall have to take note of the inconvenience or hardship that would be caused to the wife along with social and economic factors.

outcome.final_order: The petition was allowed and the case was transferred to Family Court at Shivamogga.
